messages.text: I filled out an RMA form last weekend. How long does it usully take to get an answer from the team.

RMA intake goes to the team, and you'll get a return label back once they've reviewed it. From there, processing takes up to 10 days after the unit reaches the warehouse.

If you filed it last weekend and nothing has landed yet, give me your order number and I'll push it along. Worth checking spam too, the label mail goes to the address on the order.
Thanks. What's the email on that order, or the name it ships to? One of those and I can pull it up.

Got it, Mario. That's the NerdQX that was delivered on August 8. I've pinged the team to pick your RMA up and get the label out to you, stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here, otherwise it comes to your email.

One thing I have to ask up front: was that unit overclocked or modified at all? Overclocked or tampered units aren't covered by warranty or RMA, so it's better we know now than after it ships back.
everything is written down in the RMA form. We had this conversation before.

Fair enough, sorry to make you repeat it. The form has it, and the team will work from that.

They've got your chat now and will come back with the label and the next step. Nothing more needed from you.
